body.label: Target
body.html: One eligible creature within weapon range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and it drops one non-signature held item.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense granted by cover for this Action.
Ignore 1 Defense against the primary target for this Action.

rider.title: TRICKSHOT
rider.html: If the target is Locked by you, you may shoot an object it carries or wears instead; the object is disabled until the start of its next turn.
